what: A Casio MT-40 clone inside the FM-1: the six 1981 auto-accompaniment rhythms, including the ROCK preset that became the Sleng Teng riddim (82 BPM, Wayne Smith 1985). Four drum lanes, a bass line that transposes with the one-key chord you hold, a FILL button, variation A/B, MPC swing, and nine pulse 'stairwave' voices. The keyboard keeps playing all of Felucca's engines on top.
author: Altess Production
